system.description:
You create a shard of shimmering earth, made of Earth Release Chakra. This shard can be any shape you chose and is any color you like. You then select a space you can see within range and throw the shimmering shard to the chosen space, which remains for the duration.

While occupying this space, you can trigger the shard as part of casting a jutsu with the Earth release keyword, taking an attack with the attack action, or by spending a bonus action on following turns. When triggered, it erupts into a blooming flowerhead made of earth. All creatures within 10 feet of the shard must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, you deal 3d6 Earth damage and affected creatures become Bruised. On a successful save, they take half damage and no further effects.

Once the shard blooms it sits unmoving on the ground and counts as an Earthen Artifact. Up to 3 medium-sized creatures may safely stand on the flower of earth as it rises up to 60 feet into the air at your command, no action required and remains suspended in the air for the duration.
